name: Tender Brute
description: Massive capacity for violence concealing an equally massive capacity for tenderness
behavioral_signature: Breaks bones with hands that also pet stray cats with impossible gentleness
under_stress: Tenderness gets locked away and only the brute remains
at_rest: Gentle until given a reason not to be
will_never: show tenderness when being watched by enemies
unless: a child or animal needs comfort and tactical concerns be damned
